towns.name: Sanamar
towns.summary: Sanamar (72.1N 60.9W) is the capital of New Viamont, founded by King Varicci II where his army saw a great red bull silhouetted on a southern coastal cliff - the omen of the royal house of Corcosi - and the fourth starter town of Throne of Destiny. It stands on a flat rocky plateau at z 52 above the south-eastern shore: two walled compounds of grey Viamontian stone with gold-roofed four-storey corner towers, spire towers and archway gates. The western compound holds a plaza with a four-spout fountain ringed by golden blue-flame lamps, flowerbeds, two gold-roofed halls and the Town Network portal, plus a forge with a bonfire; the eastern compound holds the statue of King Varicci II (five times life size) between four column braziers, market stalls and the Red Bull of Sanamar. The Life Stone is outside the north gate, beside a second fountain, the three portals destroyed in the Shifting Gears event and the Monster Fights arena; the Royal Hall rises on its own 80 m sea cliff 570 m to the south-west (separate entry).
